parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Filters records by ID. Separate multiple IDs with commas. A maximum of 200 IDs are supported.

parameters.name: includeSystemRecords
parameters.description: Specifies whether to include system built-in records.

parameters.name: jsonFilterAcc
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable JSON filter acceleration.

parameters.name: jsonPath
parameters.description: The JSON field path. Used together with jsonPathValue.

parameters.name: jsonPathValue
parameters.description: The filter value for the JSON field. Used together with jsonPath.

parameters.name: maxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of records to return in this request. Valid values: 1 to 200.

parameters.name: nextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token. Do not pass this parameter for the first request. For subsequent requests, pass the nextToken value returned in the previous response.

parameters.name: reverse
parameters.description: Specifies whether to traverse records in reverse order.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Searches for a specified string in record content.
